experiences.description: Leading design for India's first open-source ride-hailing platform, serving millions of users across multiple cities.
achievements: Redesigned the rider app, increasing booking completion rate by 34%
Built and scaled the design system used across 4 product lines
Led the driver onboarding experience, reducing drop-off by 28%
Established design ops practices for a team of 8 designers
learnings: Scale requires systems thinking—individual solutions don't scale
Open-source communities bring unique design challenges and opportunities
Local context matters enormously in product design

experiences.description: Led product strategy and design for a construction-tech startup digitizing home construction in India.
achievements: Launched customer app from 0 to 100K+ downloads in first year
Built internal tools reducing project management overhead by 40%
Established the company's first design team and processes
learnings: Complex B2B2C products require deep domain expertise
Internal tools deserve the same design attention as customer-facing products
Construction is ripe for thoughtful digital transformation

experiences.description: First design hire at an ed-tech startup, building the learning platform from scratch.
achievements: Designed the entire product from MVP to Series A
Created the cohort-based learning experience model
Built the instructor dashboard and course creation tools
learnings: Early-stage requires rapid iteration and strong conviction
Community features can dramatically improve learning outcomes
Great education products require understanding of pedagogy

experiences.description: Personal experiments in design, development, and creative exploration.
